item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong direct evidence that Abiy publicly retracted false claims, apologized for misinformation, or ordered corrections to state falsehoods in 2024. The clearest positive material is mostly indirect: some later-consistent statements, some de-escalatory rhetoric, and one partial clarification on the currency float. The clearest negative material is much stronger: denial of abuse allegations, scapegoating, restrictions on reporting, and punishment of journalists/watchdogs.","evidence":[{"title":"Ethiopia’s PM defends currency float amid inflation concerns","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-08-02","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Ethiopia-s-PM-defends-currency-float-amid-inflation-concerns-47541564/","summary":"Abiy said it was wrong to call the FX move a “devaluation” and argued it was meant to close the official/black-market gap. That is limited evidence of a correction/clarification rather than stubborn denial.","question_ids":["7B.2","6B.10"]},{"title":"Ethiopia Has No Intention of Harming Somalia in Any Way: PM Abiy","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-02-06","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_3975603","summary":"Official transcript shows Abiy publicly denied hostile intent toward Somalia and framed sea access as mutual benefit, which later aligned with the Ankara de-escalation. This is one of the clearest 2024 examples of straightforward public messaging.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.1"]},{"title":"Ethiopia’s leader plays down fears of conflict with Somalia over a planned naval port","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"2024-02-06","url":"https://kitchener.citynews.ca/2024/02/06/ethiopias-leader-plays-down-fears-of-conflict-with-somalia-over-a-planned-naval-port/","summary":"AP reported Abiy told lawmakers he had no intention of going to war with Somalia and also tried to reassure Egypt on the Nile dam issue. This supports some evidence of non-escalatory, publicly legible statements.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.1"]},{"title":"IMF Executive Board Approves Four-Year US$3.4 billion Extended Credit Facility Arrangement for Ethiopia","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-07-29","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/29/pr24291-ethiopia-imf-exec-board-approves-4yr-us3b-ecf-arr","summary":"Abiy had said IMF talks were in the final stage, and the IMF approved the program three weeks later. That is not a full truthfulness test, but it is consistent with a status update that tracked reality.","question_ids":["7B.2","6B.10"]},{"title":"Ethiopia rejects allegations its forces massacred civilians as the West urges an investigation","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"2024-02-15","url":"https://toronto.citynews.ca/2024/02/15/ethiopia-rejects-allegations-its-forces-massacred-civilians-as-the-west-urges-an-investigation/","summary":"Ethiopian officials denied allegations of a Merawi massacre while rights bodies said at least 45 civilians were killed. This is direct punishment of truthful reporting.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.3","7B.5"]},{"title":"Ethiopia authorities must stop using state of emergency law to silence peaceful dissent","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-02-19","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/ethiopia-authorities-must-stop-using-state-of-emergency-law-to-silence-peaceful-dissent/","summary":"Amnesty said emergency powers were used for warrantless arrests, movement limits, and bans on assemblies, and that the extension was not transparently published. That reads as blame-shifting and delegitimizing oversight rather than correcting error.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.3"]}]}
